observations.cause: MSIX LocalApplicationData redirection caused native Git to report its package-cache path rather than the supplied canonical root.

observations.diagnosedFailure: Applying the private directory owner and DACL returned an unauthorized-operation error during outer lease creation.

observations.observation: A separate read-only source-identity diagnosis refused CRLF bytes for the extensionless LICENSE file. Local core.autocrlf=false did not override the host default core.eol=crlf.
observations.resolution: Fresh clone explicitly sets both core.autocrlf=false and core.eol=lf before checkout; repository PowerShell eol=crlf attributes remain effective.

resolution: Fresh direct user-profile source/evidence hierarchy and explicit per-checkout default newline configuration passed the unchanged exact preflight. No controller, candidate, ACL policy or source validation was weakened.
publication: Raw logs, account paths, hostname, ownership descriptors and diagnostic details remain private; digests and fixed failure classifications are retained here.
